focus.label: Muscle hernia / fascial defect
focus.why: node-2 supports (asymptomatic, no trauma, recreational running increases fascial pressure); node-3 strongly supports (palpable with hip flexion, disappears on extension)

payload.query: Need dynamic ultrasound or MRI of the right anterior thigh during hip flexion and extension to confirm a fascial defect with muscle herniation, as this directly validates the leading hypothesis and excludes soft tissue tumor or inflammatory mass.
